_comment: Hand-picked showcase query per worker: shown near the top of its Orchard page, with its captured result, as 'what you get'. Keys are slugs (repo name without vgi-). capture-results.py runs these along with the catalog examples. A worker without an entry falls back to its first example that returns a real table.

nba.title: This season's NBA scoring leaders
nba.sql: SELECT player_name, team_abbreviation, games_played, points FROM nba.nba.current_player_stats WHERE games_played >= 10 ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 10

open-meteo.title: Three-day forecast for Berlin and Tokyo, looked up by city name
open-meteo.sql: SELECT p.city, d.time::DATE AS day, d.temperature_2m_max AS high_c, d.temperature_2m_min AS low_c FROM (VALUES ('Berlin'), ('Tokyo')) AS p(city), LATERAL open_meteo.main.geocoding(p.city, count := 1) AS g, LATERAL open_meteo.main.forecast_daily(g.latitude, g.longitude, forecast_days := 3, timezone := 'UTC') AS d ORDER BY p.city, day

color.title: Check text colours against WCAG contrast
color.sql: SELECT fg, bg, round(color.main.contrast_ratio(fg, bg), 2) AS contrast, color.main.wcag_level(fg, bg) AS wcag, color.main.nearest_color_name(fg) AS fg_name FROM (VALUES ('#1a1a1a', '#ffffff'), ('#767676', '#ffffff'), ('#ff6347', '#ffffff'), ('#4682b4', '#f5f5dc')) AS t(fg, bg)

conform.title: Validate and normalise a column of email addresses
conform.sql: SELECT email, conform.main.is_valid_email(email) AS valid, conform.main.normalize_email(email) AS normalized, conform.main.email_domain(email) AS domain FROM (VALUES ('Jane.Doe@Example.COM'), ('ops@query.farm'), ('billing@Sub.Example.org')) AS t(email)
